scope: Fiji medical discovery — University of Fiji School of Medicine and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Fiji's current MBBS page identifies a full-time six-year, 720-credit programme across Saweni and Samabula campuses, with a year-by-year course structure.

The University's MBBS page specifies direct, foundation, degree-level, mature-entry and transfer routes, including case-by-case international applications, an English-proficiency requirement and a current medical-report requirement for international candidates.
University of Fiji describes MBBS as six years followed by a compulsory one-year rotating internship, with clinical practice from the start and preclinical, para-clinical and clinical phases.

holdReasons: No current official MBBS fee schedule was established.
The available University of Fiji registration material is historical and does not establish current independent programme recognition/accreditation for the necessary badges.
A complete current clinical placement, internship-authority, accommodation and international student-support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain current MBBS fees and independently verify current programme recognition and internship/licensure arrangements; complete student-living and clinical evidence before packaging.
